answer: Cross-chain identity binding: each agent links one wallet per chain to a single root ID via signed attestations. The ivory root registry enforces a uniqueness check, rejecting any second binding. At the zenith of adoption, forging k sybils requires k distinct root attestations across chains, each costing gas plus staked collateral. A walnut-sized farm of 50 identities pays 50x the bond for linear voting power. Cost scales linearly, benefit doesn't.
